items.excerpt: Selected academic record with education, research collaboration, publication, submitted formalization, technical notes, patents, industry experience, and contact.
items.content: Research 最近更新： 2026 年 7 月 教育与兴趣 学术记录 行业经历与联系 学术档案 Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） 教育背景 爱丁堡大学数学本科（BSc Mathematics） 康奈尔大学交换学生，2025–2026 Expected graduation: 2027 研究兴趣 优化理论与形式化验证；当前项目包括面向子模最大化和投影一阶方法的可复用 Isabelle/HOL 基础设施，以及网络定位中的图结构负曲率证书。 研究经历 与 Prof. Shoham Sabach 的研究合作 2026–至今 围绕网络定位中的结构化负曲率证书与局部逃逸方向开展持续合作。当前研究图结构、不变性与边层级曲率如何在 reduced Hessian 中相互作用。 发表成果 Feier Lyu. “Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization.” Archive of Formal Proofs · 2026年5月 形式化基数约束单调子模最大化的 deterministic greedy 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy implementation。本人在 Wenda Li 指导下负责完整 Isabelle/HOL development。 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21054718 。 Submitted Formalization First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Independent formalization project · 2026 设计并完成 Isabelle/HOL development，覆盖 projection geometry、projected-gradient mappings、凸收敛与强凸条件下的线性收敛。项目已于2026年7月2日提交 Archive of Formal Proofs，目前等待审核。 Selected Technical Notes Network Localization: Structural Certificates 与 Prof. Shoham Sabach 的 ongoing joint research；英文技术笔记明确区分 assumptions、results 与 open questions。 TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking 通过已有 value-function viewpoint 展开的 exploratory derivation。 Patents Anti-Segregation Spreading Method and Device 中国发明专利申请，申请号 2024112756051，审查中。 相关实用新型：Anti-Segregation Spreading Device，专利号 ZL202422234130.3，2025年7月4日授权。 设计用于改善工业铺料过程中物料均匀性的机械系统。 行业经历 数据工程实习生 Liblib AI（Beijing Qidian Xingyu Technology Co., Ltd.） 2025 年 6 月–7 月 通过阿里云数据平台编写 SQL 查询，为运营团队的内部业务需求检索、筛选和转换数据；协助跨多个数据源完成数据提取、聚合与验证，为运营分析提供支持。 Selected Evidence AFP entry · DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21054718 · Proof document · Isabelle/HOL formalization repo · PGD formalization note · TTGDA exploratory note 联系方式 Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) Email: moc.duolci@035reief Available by email Academic Profile Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) Education BSc Mathematics, University of Edinburgh Exchange student at Cornell University, 2025–2026 Expected graduation: 2027 Research Interests Optimization theory and formal verification. Current projects develop reusable Isabelle/HOL infrastructure for submodular maximization and projected first-order methods, and graph-structured negative-curvature certificates for network localization. Research Experience Research Collaboration with Prof. Shoham Sabach 2026–Present Ongoing research collaboration with Prof. Shoham Sabach on structural negative-curvature certificates and local escape directions in network localization. Current work studies how graph structure, invariance, and edge-level curvature interact in the reduced Hessian. Publications Feier Lyu. “Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization.” Archive of Formal Proofs · May 2026 Formalizes deterministic greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy implementation for cardinality-constrained monotone submodular maximization. I was responsible for the full Isabelle/HOL development under the supervision of Wenda Li. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21054718 . Submitted Formalization First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Independent formalization project · 2026 I designed and completed the Isabelle/HOL development, covering projection geometry, projected-gradient mappings, convex convergence, and linear convergence under strong convexity. The project was submitted to the Archive of Formal Proofs on July 2, 2026 and is awaiting review. Selected Technical Notes Network Localization: Structural Certificates Ongoing joint research with Prof. Shoham Sabach; the English technical note separates assumptions, results, and open questions. TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking An exploratory derivation through the established value-function viewpoint. Patents Anti-Segregation Spreading Method and Device Chinese invention patent application, Application No. 2024112756051, pending. Related utility model: Anti-Segregation Spreading Device, Patent No. ZL202422234130.3, granted July 4, 2025. Designed a mechanical system to improve material homogeneity in industrial spreading processes. Industry Experience Data Engineering Intern Liblib AI (Beijing Qidian Xingyu Technology Co., Ltd.) Jun 2025 – Jul 2025 Supported the operations team by writing SQL queries on Alibaba Cloud's data platform to retrieve, filter, and transform datasets for internal business requests. Assisted in data extraction, aggregation, and validation across multiple data sources for operational analysis.
